pages.text: $(bold)Blazing$() (default tool trait of Pyrium, $(bold)leveled$())$(br2)Each attack has a $(bold)5% x level$() chance to set the target on fire for $(bold)5 seconds$(), and appends $(bold)Fire-school spell damage$() equal to $(bold)0.1 x (level + 1)$() of the hit after it resolves (20% at level 1, 40% at level 3).$(br2)The burst is attributed to the player, so Life Lamp Ring mercy and true piercing apply to it too.
